title: The First Gym Session
description: You finally sign up at a gym. Walking in feels like entering a foreign country—everyone seems to know what they're doing. A ripped guy grunts on the leg press. Women in matching athleisure flow between machines. You stand near the cardio section, uncertain which machine to try first.

outcomes.narration: You hop on a treadmill, start at a comfortable pace, then gradually increase. After 20 minutes, you venture to the weights—watching others first, then mimicking. By the end, you're sweating and feel accomplished. Not bad for day one.

You attempt the leg press, set the weight too high, and when you try to push, something in your knee protests sharply. You end up stretching lightly on a mat, embarrassed, watching others. Not the start you wanted.

choices.label: Ask a staff member for guidance

outcomes.narration: A trainer named Marcus shows you the basics—proper form, beginner routines, realistic expectations. 'Everyone starts somewhere,' he says kindly. You leave with a plan and a coupon for a free session. For once, admitting you don't know something paid off.
You walk around, feel overwhelmed, and leave before touching anything. The membership sits unused for weeks. You tell yourself you'll try again, but the intimidation has planted a seed of defeat.
